authority.rule: Accepted brief clause 8.1 makes input selection semantic: option-contract calculations require matching underlying, expiry, strike, option right and contract identity wherever material; exact contract/expiry/delta/strike matching is required unless the row explicitly defines interpolation/bucketing. Clause 17 requires fail-closed behaviour on missing matching prerequisites.

finding: The prior mandatory single-instrument subject repair is effective, but the same input-selection class remains incomplete for option-contract joins. InputSelectionPolicyVersion.join_keys is accepted with contract_id, yet the Stage-1 owner does not enforce that join dimension. In an independent public-seam D087 probe, the bid input was designated as contract-C1 and the ask input as contract-C2, both under NVDA, while the selection policy declared join_keys=('contract_id',). The owner materialised D087=101 and retained both mismatched observations in raw lineage. The current RawInputBindingV1 and M00 ProjectedRawValueV1 surfaces expose no exact option-contract identity for this comparison, and implementation use of join_keys is absent beyond the now-unconditional subject special case.

independent_evidence.note: Green tests do not establish the missing contract-join semantic. Review stopped at the first remaining failed Stage-1 invariant after confirming the prior recurrent subject repair.

prior_recurrent_subject_repair.status: the adverse join_keys-without-subject witness is now refused

repair_proposition: Close the Stage-1 input-selection class at the accepted clause-8.1 boundary, not by another single witness patch. Mandatory join dimensions must be mechanically enforceable and fail closed for the rows where they are material, including exact option contract/underlying/expiry/strike/right matching and the already-required subject/time laws. A supplied InputSelectionPolicyVersion must not advertise a join key that the public selection path cannot actually evaluate. If the current admitted M00 projection lacks a required identity dimension, establish and evidence the smallest lawful seam extension under the current plan before production behaviour changes. Do not start Stage 2.
